title: The Final Stop on Route 9

beats.text: The dashboard clock flickers to midnight on November 26th, 2026, casting a pale, sickly light over Elias’s white-knuckled grip on the steering wheel.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a bus driver's hands on a steering wheel, dark foggy windows

beats.text: In the back row sits a passenger in a damp yellow coat, her face hidden by the thick, freezing fog pressing against the windows.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome interior of a dark bus, one passenger in a yellow coat in the back row, fog outside

beats.text: She hasn't pulled the cord in twenty miles, and Elias whispers to the empty rearview mirror that the fare is paid in full.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome view of a bus rearview mirror reflecting an empty seat and thick fog

beats.text: He stops at the final depot, but the doors remain sealed shut as the smell of stagnant pond water slowly fills the cabin.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome abandoned bus terminal at night with thick mist swirling around the tires

beats.text: The passenger steps forward and Elias sees his own name on the hospital tag on her wrist, finally realizing the fare is paid in full.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a pale hand with a hospital wristband reaching toward the driver

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
